stem: Rooting percentage improves, but a larger share of rooted cuttings are later culled for poor quality. What should Technician II conclude?
choices: Propagation performance improved because rooting percentage is the only meaningful KPI
The early KPI improved while downstream quality worsened; evaluate the full process outcome before claiming improvement
Cull rate is unrelated to propagation
Increase the rooting target without reviewing culls
rationale: A single upstream success metric can hide downstream losses. Useful KPI review connects related outcomes across the process.
